decisions.reason: The schlager compilation draws on the label's core compilation and reissue know-how and supports its genre-broadening strategy, but it has not been visible on the website since 2018, which weakens the evidence that it still sells.
The reissued jazz vinyl LP builds directly on the firm's deep expertise in reissuing overlooked music and its warehouse catalog, so management can interpret demand and keep it available at low cost.
The multi-disc box set fits the firm's careful-edition know-how, but limited-run box sets often sell out and are not repressed, which raises the chance it leaves the market.

The compilation CD lies close to the label's established skills and costs little to keep in a large catalog, though the declining CD format and its only marginal presence on the website add some risk of discontinuation.
